question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2220e7622ab780333b96cd13e2d7e99f601409fe32d6beaaf565c5cdd386d29.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• Pentagon is rotated right side 90 degrees from figure to figure.
 
• Undotted is dotted from and dotted is undotted from figure to figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e982129dd1b49e8c0e3f7eb96b9ad3a353148b038774de1241efd05e92ffc79d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
